title: TrueCraft+
description: TrueCraft+ enhances the core Minecraft experience while preserving its authentic feel. Every mod has been handpicked to expand creativity, improve exploration, and add functionality — all without losing the charm of true vanilla gameplay.
body:
This is Minecraft as it should be — refined, expanded, and true.

Key Features
🧱 Expanded Building & World Interaction
- Add hundreds of new construction and decoration options with the complete lineup of Macaw’s Mods.
- Bring your world to life with Supplementaries, adding immersive functional blocks, decorative items, and interactable utilities.
  
⚔️ Better Combat & Gameplay Feel
- Better Combat delivers smooth, modernized melee animations and weapon handling for a more dynamic fighting experience.
- Guard Villagers strengthens village protection with combat-capable villagers who defend against threats.
  
📦 Enhanced Storage Systems
- Stay organized with Iron Chest offering expandable inventory solutions.
  
🌎 Beautiful World Generation
- Explore fresh landscapes and diverse biomes with Oh The Biomes We've Gone, adding depth and visual richness to every journey.
  
🏰 Improved Structures & Villages
- Encounter unique new structures with Towns and Towers, creating a more vibrant and lived-in world.
  
🐲 Expanded Nether & End Content
- Nether Delight brings new cooking, food items, and utilities to enrich your adventures in the fiery dimension.
- End Delight introduces flavorful new foods and mechanics for the mysterious End.
  
🎨 Enhanced Visual Detail
- Entity Texture Features (ETF) adds support for emissive textures, random mob variants, and more visual depth.
- Entity Model Features (EMF) brings advanced entity model enhancements for a richer visual experience.


Why TrueCraft+?
TrueCraft+ stays faithful to Minecraft’s foundation while enriching it with depth, creativity, and modern improvements. It’s the perfect Vanilla+ experience — balanced, immersive, and endlessly replayable.

Rediscover the adventure. Play Minecraft the TrueCraft+ way.
